title: Customer Education Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
Build and run training for our customers.

What you'll do
- Create learning materials, webinars and certification paths

What you bring
- 3+ years in training or customer education
- Authoring tools and LMS knowledge
- You will work from our Cologne office five days a week; remote work is not available for this role
